name: KolektorSDD2: Kolektor Surface-Defect Dataset 2
description: Expanded surface-defect detection dataset comprising 3,335 high-resolution color images (approx. 230x630 resolution) of electrical commutators provided by Kolektor Group. Contains 356 images with diverse surface defects (scratches, minor spots, surface cracks) with pixel-level ground truth masks, and 2,979 defect-free images, partitioned into standardized training (2,331 images) and testing (1,004 images) splits.

provenance.curation_notes: Train set comprises 246 positive (defective) and 2,085 negative images; test set comprises 110 positive and 894 negative images. Fine segmentation masks are provided for all positive instances.
